What was copied
- frontend/src -> /src (tests and snapshots removed; local-mode patches
  in src/local, src/router/server-axios.ts, and the login / settings /
  recipe screens)
- frontend/public -> /public
- common/src -> third_party/nerolis-lab/common/src (tests removed)
- backend/src simulation -> third_party/nerolis-lab/engine/src
  (tests, database, routes, middleware, and controllers removed)

Local changes vs upstream
- POST /calculator/team and /calculator/iv run calculateTeam / calculateIv
  in the browser (400 and 200 Monte Carlo iterations; upstream server
  defaults are 5110 and 1400).
- Pinia localStorage is mirrored to IndexedDB (neroli-pocket / kv).
- Recipe levels, area bonus, and pot size work without an account.
- OAuth, cloud sync, friends, notifications, admin, guides, and the
  tier list page are not wired to a server.
